init_Kappa103Reducer: create a Kappa103Reducer instance with a benchmark name and optional target data path for kappa thermal conductivity benchmarking
compute_metrics_Kappa103Reducer: compute kappa SRE and SRME metrics from a results DataFrame using the Kappa103Reducer compute_metrics method
runner_type_Kappa103Reducer: get the KappaRunner type associated with the Kappa103Reducer via its runner_type property
save_state_Kappa103Reducer: call save_state on a Kappa103Reducer instance to checkpoint benchmark state at a given location
load_state_Kappa103Reducer: call load_state on a Kappa103Reducer instance to restore benchmark state from a checkpoint location
